title: Distinct indices in a Tseitin clause chain
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let the literals and auxiliary literals be two lists whose variable indices are each pairwise distinct and whose sets of indices are disjoint. Then every clause in the Tseitin clause chain formed from these lists has pairwise distinct variable indices.
hypotheses_covered: The literal list has no repeated variable indices
The auxiliary list has no repeated variable indices
The two lists have disjoint sets of variable indices
